images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: dwelling | on

facade.notes: Lucas County Auditor block card (tax-assessment photo, parcel number in frame): a one-storey gable-front worker's cottage, the door with a transom at one side and two tall windows, a TV antenna on the ridge, neighbours a few feet away on both sides; bare yard

why.note: the cheapest house of the industrial city: a one-storey gable-front box on a 25-30 ft lot near the plants
